name: FaceScreen
tagline: Put a floating camera feed and name label on your Mac screen for live demos and recordings.
description:
FaceScreen places a live camera window above other apps. Position it where it will stay visible when you share your screen and add a label for your name or a short note.

## Features
- Adjust the camera overlay's size, shape, and position.
- Add a custom text label and change its style.
- Toggle the camera with a shortcut during a presentation.

## Privacy and requirements
The app requires camera access to show the feed. Check where the overlay sits before sharing or recording the screen, since it can appear in the capture.

## Pricing
The direct license is a $5.99 one-time purchase.
